policies.text: International shipping insurance is issued upon presentation of a clean bill of lading.
Identity verification approval is granted when an applicant submits a verified tax identification document.
Financial stability verification is granted when a firm maintains an institutional cash deposit of at least $10,000,000 alongside liquid reserves of no less than $3,000,000.
Global execution permissions are granted to a firm meeting transaction monitoring compliance that maintains a valid tier-one banking license.
Regulatory governance validation requires either maintaining zero regulatory flags on record, holding an ISO 27001 security certificate, or employing a minimum of 2 dedicated compliance officers.
Standard account clearance is granted to an applicant maintaining essential liquidity provisioning who presents a verified corporate ownership registry certificate.
Transaction monitoring compliance is achieved by an entity with financial stability verification that registers a quarterly count of at least 10 international wire transfers.
Full exchange clearance is granted to any corporate entity holding institutional prime status.
Internal oversight standards are met when a firm maintains 3 or more active compliance monitors.
Secondary account access is granted to an entity with compliance staffing adequacy that holds standard account clearance.
Compliance staffing adequacy is confirmed when an enterprise maintains at least 2 dedicated compliance officers.
Operating authorization validation requires holding an official brokerage operating license.
Commercial lending eligibility is extended to a corporate entity in active existence for over five years.
High-volume trade handling is available to an enterprise recording an annual trading volume of at least $50,000,000.
Essential liquidity provisioning is established when an entity maintains an institutional cash deposit of $10,000,000 or greater.
Institutional prime status is awarded to an organization holding regulatory governance validation that possesses global execution permissions.
Supplementary risk assessment is satisfied either through an independent audit rating of 90 points or higher, or by maintaining a risk reserve of at least $2,000,000.
Tier-two trading rights are assigned to a firm meeting supplementary risk assessment that possesses standard account clearance.
